name: USDA Report Sick Birds line
region_note: WILDLIFE REPORTING LINES - who to call about sick, dead, stranded or illegally kept wildlife. Reporting lines only: for a live injured animal use the wildlife carers above.
notes: USDA's Report Sick Birds line, run for poultry and backyard flocks; it also takes reports of sick or dead wild birds and routes them to the right agency. For a live injured bird call the city's wildlife hospital instead. Do not touch dead birds with bare hands; in the city you can also report dead birds to 311.
type_raw: Federal reporting line for sick or dead birds, run for avian influenza surveillance; a reporting line that does not collect animals
